entity_1_name: A type of visual co-occurrence used by ViCo, computed using ImageNet annotations augmented with WordNet hypernyms.
entity_2_name: A type of visual co-occurrence used by ViCo, calculated using ImageNet synsets and their ancestors in WordNet.

entity_1_name: Co-occurrence counts (X oa) computed for each region in VisualGenome, incremented by 1 for each word pair (i, j) from object synsets (S o) and attribute synsets (S a), and for all synset pairs (S o, S a) in O × A.
entity_2_name: Co-occurrence counts (X aa) computed for each region in VisualGenome, incremented by 1 for each word pair (i, j) from attribute synsets (S a1 and S a2), and for all synset pairs (S a1, S a2) in A × A.
